provenance.paper_title: AniME: Adaptive Multi-Agent Planning for Long Animation Generation

evidence.paraphrase: The director maintains global workflow and asset state used by downstream animation agents.

The director's fixed coordination workflow updates global production state as assets are created. For AniME, this specifically supports fixed-rule insertion or replacement of global production memory.

Production state is revised when downstream agents return updated assets and control conditions. For AniME, this specifically supports fixed-rule correction of stored state of global production memory.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 3): During inference, the operative memory component (global production memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, fixed-rule correction of stored state; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
